scope: One bounded economics discovery pass, including the added stablecoin-variant candidate test.
counting_rules: A recovered official legacy FAQ counts as one substantive priority reading, not a successful read of the missing original URL.
Repeated chunks of the same paper are fetches, not additional sources.
Metadata triage and search snippets are not completed document readings.
Selected-section reading is distinguished from full substantive-body reading; testnet tables and site configuration are not evidence reviewed.
Mutable documentation retrieved on this date is not a historical state proof, measured latency distribution, executable quote or transaction receipt.
Null publication dates mean unknown; citation years are not substituted for publication dates.
The six candidate-specific extra fetches and two candidate-specific searches were separately authorized within this same pass.

assigned_sources.title: FAQ | Across Documentation
assigned_sources.access_status: Original returned a short missing-page response; same-path official legacy host contained the substantive FAQ.
assigned_sources.relevance: Relayers front destination funds; pooled liquidity reimburses them. Legacy fill-time estimates depend on available liquidity.
assigned_sources.limits: Legacy chain list and 2022 airdrop material are stale. Relative last-updated text does not establish a publication date or current settlement SLA.

assigned_sources.title: Exploring Cross-Chain Solutions: how to Bridge Into Arbitrum
assigned_sources.data_window: Historical 2023 bridge context; no current executable market sample.
assigned_sources.relevance: Separates canonical bridge settlement from third-party messaging/swap routes; prompted checking actual recent Axelar deployments.
assigned_sources.limits: Displayed publication is 2023, not the inventory's 2025 citation year. Historical volumes and withdrawal estimates are not current quotes or an SLA.

assigned_sources.title: FAQ | Celer cBridge
assigned_sources.relevance: Some xLiquidity pairs use StableSwap; rebalancing can give more destination tokens, with the LP bearing the value transfer. Distinguishes xAsset from xLiquidity.
assigned_sources.limits: Numerical examples and advertised fee ranges are not actual route quotes, proof of available capacity, or proof that two stablecoin contracts have equal redemption rights.

assigned_sources.title: Transaction Support FAQ | Synapse Docs
assigned_sources.relevance: Destination slippage fallback can deliver an intermediate asset rather than the requested final token; delayed completion and manual recovery affect inventory.
assigned_sources.limits: An intermediate asset, refund or gas airdrop is not independent profit. Failed initiation preserving principal does not establish zero gas cost.

assigned_sources.limits: No current Base execution, fee, token mapping or liquidity evidence was obtained from this citation.

supplemental_sources.title: Cross-Chain Arbitrage: The Next Frontier of MEV in Decentralized Finance
supplemental_sources.data_window: 2023-09 through 2024-08 empirical study; Appendix G transaction dates not independently established.
supplemental_sources.sections: Economic assumptions, measurement/cost limitations, related references and all of Appendix G. Not a claim of auditing every derivation.
supplemental_sources.relevance: Author-reported ordinary collateralized borrowing closes inventory before bridge arrival. Theoretical zero-cost assumptions and empirical unpriced inventory risk limit profit interpretation.
supplemental_sources.limits: Three chunks are one source. Paper-linked explorer references were not fetched; reported historical transaction profit is not independently reconciled.

supplemental_sources.title: Fees in the System | Across Docs
supplemental_sources.relevance: Origin-chain repayment can eliminate the LP-fee component; relayer gas/capital/risk costs remain. The old suggested-fees endpoint is deprecated for new integrations.
supplemental_sources.limits: Zero LP fee is not zero total cost. No current Swap API quote or repayment receipt was obtained.

supplemental_sources.title: Running a Relayer | Across Docs
supplemental_sources.relevance: Existing relayer inventory targets and repayment selection make capital management concrete but also demonstrate incumbent competition.
supplemental_sources.limits: No software was installed or run. Bundle timing descriptions are not measured latency tails; eligibility and competitive fill access remain unknown.

supplemental_sources.title: Axelar Integrates Solana Mainnet
supplemental_sources.relevance: Actual in-window mainnet-live announcement, including SHx from Stellar and SAUCE from Hedera to Solana as stated launch use cases.
supplemental_sources.limits: Provider-reported deployment, not independent contract/mint, pool-liquidity or transaction verification.

supplemental_sources.title: CCTP fees - Circle Docs
supplemental_sources.data_window: Mutable fee documentation retrieved on 2026-10-29, not a sampled quote series.
supplemental_sources.relevance: Standard/native-USDC route and Fast fee components, route variation, allowance and version-specific Standard fee switch.
supplemental_sources.limits: The page has conflicting maxFee failure descriptions and a free-Standard headline plus fee-switch exceptions. Do not infer runtime behavior without version/route verification or treat gas as free.

supplemental_sources.data_window: Aggregate calibration 2025-09 through 2026-03; swap samples 2026-02-22 through 2026-02-25 and 2026-03-23.
supplemental_sources.sections: Sections 1-3, 5.1-5.4, 6 and references. Attack-oriented material context-only and excluded from mechanism construction.

supplemental_sources.limits: Binned price differences and simulated success probabilities are not executable bid/ask quotes, observed fills or closed-account net profit. Chain aggregate fee totals are not per-transaction fees.

supplemental_sources.title: Technical FAQ | Across Docs

research_limits: No current AMM pool, paid quote, on-chain state, explorer receipt, fill or closed economic cycle was collected.
No independently read legal/onboarding terms establish fiat-redemption access, KYC, jurisdiction or minimums for the user.
USDT/USDT0 and USDG were not separately researched; the candidate test intentionally uses the smaller Ethereum/Arbitrum USDC subset.
No protocol/instrument audit, TVL, portfolio concentration, pathwise monthly drawdown or annual tail-probability qualification was completed.
No new collectors, simulators, installs, servers, signatures or transactions were used.
